rules.ratios: Aggregate raw numerators and denominators; never average partition percentages.
rules.ranking: Macro-average per annotated query. Unannotated queries are N/A.
rules.timing: Aggregate raw completed-call durations. Percentiles use the combined observations.
rules.not_applicable: Use N/A when independent labels or a non-zero denominator are unavailable.

metrics.name: Codex score
metrics.formula: weighted sum of six criterion scores
metrics.required_labels: gold answer, expected behavior, failure conditions, corpus evidence
metrics.numerator: sum of weighted applicable criterion scores
metrics.na_rule: N/A when a criterion cannot be independently verified

metrics.name: Required Fact Recall
metrics.formula: confirmed required facts / independently labelled required facts

metrics.name: Claim Support Rate
metrics.formula: supported published claims / reviewed published claims

metrics.name: Citation Coverage
metrics.formula: answers with required grounded citations / substantive answers requiring citations
metrics.na_rule: N/A when citations are not applicable

metrics.name: False Refusal Rate
metrics.na_rule: N/A with no independently confirmed answerable cases

metrics.name: Precision Recall F1
metrics.formula: sklearn.metrics precision_score, recall_score, f1_score when scikit-learn is installed; otherwise N/A
metrics.na_rule: N/A without labels or compatible installed library

metrics.name: Recall@K
metrics.formula: relevant items in top K / independently labelled relevant items

metrics.name: Precision@K
metrics.formula: relevant items in top K / returned items up to K
metrics.na_rule: N/A for unannotated or empty-return queries

metrics.name: MRR@K
metrics.formula: reciprocal rank of first relevant item at or before K
metrics.na_rule: N/A for unannotated queries; zero when annotated and no hit

metrics.name: nDCG@K
metrics.formula: existing submission.evaluate_quality implementation; sklearn.metrics.ndcg_score only for compatible dense labels

metrics.name: Evidence Selection Loss
metrics.formula: relevant retrieved evidence omitted from selected evidence / relevant retrieved evidence
metrics.required_labels: relevant evidence before and after selection

metrics.name: Recovery Success Rate
metrics.formula: revisions passing repeated validation / revision attempts
metrics.na_rule: N/A when no revision was attempted

metrics.name: Stage duration
metrics.averaging: count, total, mean, p50, p95, p99, max over raw observations
metrics.na_rule: N/A when the stage was not executed
